svg.title: Bot Framework Runtime Architecture & Trust Boundaries
svg.desc: Gateway, Scheduler, and Admin commit requests and approvals to PostgreSQL (bot-store), while the trusted host Worker and Broker (single authorization gate) run isolated Model VMs, upstream Model APIs, MCP tool sandboxes (srt), and remote MCP servers.

g.text: ARCHITECTURE · BOT FRAMEWORK · RUNTIME & TRUST BOUNDARIES
Single binary (bot serve --role all) loads profiles, commits to PostgreSQL first, and executes via the broker gate & sandboxes
Host-only keys · Leak guard on reply
Models never touch the host or service keys
(VM session token / API host header inject)
All tool auth, approvals, and auditing pass
Request accepted only on PostgreSQL commit
